wins: Maintained consistent reward accumulation (40) despite mentor interventions, indicating learning progress on intermediate tasks.
Engaged mentor inputs 10 times, suggesting active troubleshooting and opportunity for guided corrections.
fails: Zero success rate indicates inability to translate accumulated reward into mission completion—final validation gate repeatedly missed.
Dependency on mentor assistance remained high; no autonomous resolution observed.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent can gather points but repeatedly stalls before mission success; needs refinement on finishing objectives without mentor intervention.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stalls at final objective verification despite completing preliminary steps, resulting in consistent mission failure.
